# Update card geometry when row count, font size or density changes

The 1865057 feature stores the card row count separately from the cards/table view. Its lazy getter clamps the consumed value to 2–3; it does not rewrite an invalid stored preference. Row-count, font-size and density changes recalculate the virtual row height, toggle cards-row-compact and reset the thread tree. The CSS/template has a separate compact grid, so the virtual height and rendered layout must stay aligned. The direct Appearance test checks preference/row/class/option state and horizontal scrolling, not measured pixel heights or a cross-platform font/density/accessibility matrix. Bug comment4 is unavailable, so this complete 55-file source study receives zero full-audit credit. No UI/test execution ran.

Scope: Thread card size and virtual layout.
